entries.content: Root cause analysis on September's empty package spike: 73% traced to Warehouse B's new tape gun malfunction causing seal failures during transit. Remaining cases distributed across normal variance. Carrier liability claims filed for 12 confirmed theft incidents on Route 7.

Compliance flagged two chargebacks from Q4 where we denied refunds citing 'pattern of similar claims' without individual case investigation. Both ruled in customer favor. Payment processor warned that pattern-based denials without case-specific evidence create liability exposure.
